finding.summary: 论文要求移入独立 relegated 队列；代码仅设 drop 标志并放回原 prefill 队列，无 relegated 队列结构，且 drop 请求仍可被再次选中调度。（artifact 范围：。）

paper.quote: if a request has already violated its TTFT / TTLT deadline, or is about to violate it in the current iteration, then QoServe de-prioritizes this request into a relegated queue

analysis.tier_note: the probes confirm what the Finding says
analysis.reasoning: The code confirms the finding: when a request is about to miss its TTFT deadline, it increments seq.drop and pushes the same sequence back into self._prefill_queue. There is no separate relegated queue. The __lt__ method only orders dropped requests after non-dropped ones, so dropped requests remain in the prefill heap and can still be selected later.
analysis.would_confirm: A code inspection or test showing whether dropped requests are placed in a distinct queue and excluded from normal prefill scheduling would settle it.

probes.meaning: No relegated queue name appears in scheduler code.
Drop flag is set instead of moving request.
Dropped request is reinserted into original prefill queue.
Drop flag only affects ordering, not queue membership.
